caveats: Region spans 3600 grid cells (lat 59.94-61.12 N, lon 18.70-19.88 E on the dataset grid); 3302 cells with finite SST on all 92 target days were used as sea cells, 298 land cells excluded (0 in the mask). Per-day-of-year pools use the 1992-2002 baseline with +/-5-day windows; per the method, the end windows also use 1991-12-27 to 1991-12-31 and 2003-01-01 to 2003-01-05. Threshold = 90th percentile (Hazen type-5), climatology = mean, NaN ignored; day of year 60 set to the mean of 59 and 61; both smoothed with a 31-day centred wrap-around moving mean. SST compared in kelvin as stored. Hot days >= smoothed threshold; per-cell MHW = run of >=5 consecutive hot days, with runs separated by 1-2 non-hot days joined (gap days included). 2 regional events found; 17 active days of 92.
